ὑποσπᾰθ-ισμός , ὁ,
A.an operation for eye-affections, wherein a spatula (cf. sq.) is introduced under the skin of the scalp to produce lines of scar tissue on the forehead, Gal. 14.784 , Paul.Aeg. 6.6 : cf. ὑπο-, περι-σκυφισμός.
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
